slides_data.author: markjborg
slides_data.text: @NASASpaceflight Booster 22 getting craned into place like the world's most expensive LEGO piece. Flight 15, let's go.

slides_data.author: markjborg
slides_data.text: @NASASpaceflight 33 engines and every single one has to agree. I can't get two group chats to do that.

slides_data.author: markjborg
slides_data.text: @NASASpaceflight Catching the booster was the magic trick. Catching both ends on one flight is them asking if the encore can just be the new normal.
